_comment: ÓRBITA on the HCL Simple theme: what install.mjs creates in the target portal. Secrets go in .env.local, never here.

libraries._comment: theme: theme contents (customColors.css, headerNav, logo, footer...) and the authoring templates of wcm/templates.json. content: the parent site area with the Setting fields and one area per page.

theme._comment: Copy of the static part (WebDAV) of the base theme + our theme/theme.html + nls/ generated for each language of theme/nls.json. The dynamic part (st_* spots) stays the one of the base theme in the server. Same names as the ÓRBITA chart.
theme.title: ÓRBITA

description.en: ÓRBITA theme (copy of the HCL DX Simple theme, header and footer from WCM)
description.es: Tema de ÓRBITA (copia del tema Simple de HCL DX, cabecera y pie desde WCM)

theme._wcmPath: Library/site area of the theme WCM contents (customColors.css, headerNav.css, logo, footer...). theme.html says ThemeDS/ThemeSetting; it is replaced with this value.
theme._languages: Codes of theme/nls.json to generate. [] = no nls folder (only theme.html).

access._comment: Roles given on the libraries of libraries (theme and content): the theme reads their contents, logos and colors on every page, also for anonymous users. Principals are only added, never removed.
